title: Escape the Gallows
tagline: Five rooms, five ciphers, six mistakes before the room wins.
teaser: The owner's earlier port of the Berkeley word-guessing game as an escape through five rooms: a flooding pirate hold, a gassed laboratory, a tomb filling with sand, a crypt where the Count draws near, a starship losing its air. Guess each door's cipher before the room wins. Every picture drawn in code.

manPage.synopsis: escape the gallows — guess a door's cipher letter by letter before the room's trap closes; six mistakes and it wins.
manPage.description: The owner's earlier fancy-web port of hangman, reframed as an escape through five themed rooms, each with its own cipher list, its own threat and its own end: the Pirate's Hold floods and Captain Blackrot comes apart on the water; poison gas fills the Alchemist's Laboratory and Doktor Formalin sinks a little with every miss; sand pours into the Pharaoh's Tomb while the mummy walks; Count Nachtvorn crosses the Vampire's Crypt towards his prisoner; the Void Vessel's air monitors go from nominal to danger as the oxygen runs out. Six mistakes end a room; solving a cipher opens the door and names the room's boss and the first letter of its weakness. Every picture is drawn in code. A second interpretation beside the collection's own Before the Tide.

howToPlay: Type a letter, or click it on the keyboard below the room, to guess it in the door's cipher.
Each wrong letter springs the room's trap a little further; the sixth ends the room.
Choose a room with the buttons at the top; Enter or the overlay's button starts the next cipher.
